shortDescription: Manage filesystem on Unity storage system

options.name: access_policy
options.description: Access policy of a filesystem.

options.name: cap_unit
options.description: The unit of the filesystem size. It defaults to C(GB), if not specified.

options.name: data_reduction
options.description: Boolean variable, specifies whether or not to enable compression. Compression is supported only for thin filesystem.

options.name: description
options.description: Description about the filesystem. Description can be removed by passing empty string ("").

options.name: filesystem_id
options.description: The id of the filesystem. It can be used only for get, modify, or delete operations. It is mutually exclusive with I(filesystem_name).

options.name: filesystem_name
options.description: The name of the filesystem. Mandatory only for the create operation. All the operations are supported through I(filesystem_name). It is mutually exclusive with I(filesystem_id).

options.name: is_thin
options.description: Boolean variable, specifies whether or not it is a thin filesystem.

options.name: locking_policy
options.description: File system locking policies. These policy choices control whether the NFSv4 range locks must be honored.

options.name: nas_server_id
options.description: ID of the NAS server on which filesystem will be hosted.

options.name: nas_server_name
options.description: Name of the NAS server on which filesystem will be hosted.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unity management server.

options.name: pool_id
options.description: This is the ID of the pool where the filesystem will be created. Either the I(pool_name) or I(pool_id) must be provided to create a new filesystem.

options.name: pool_name
options.description: This is the name of the pool where the filesystem will be created. Either the I(pool_name) or I(pool_id) must be provided to create a new filesystem.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with Unity management server.

options.name: quota_config
options.description: Configuration for quota management. It contains optional parameters.

options.name: replication_params
options.description: Settings required for enabling or modifying replication.

options.name: replication_state
options.description: State of the replication.

options.name: size
options.description: The size of the filesystem.

options.name: smb_properties
options.description: Advance settings for SMB. It contains optional candidate variables.

options.name: snap_schedule_id
options.description: This is the id of an existing snapshot schedule which is to be associated with the filesystem. This is mutually exclusive with I(snapshot_schedule_name).

options.name: snap_schedule_name
options.description: This is the name of an existing snapshot schedule which is to be associated with the filesystem. This is mutually exclusive with I(snapshot_schedule_id).

options.name: state
options.description: State variable to determine whether filesystem will exist or not.

options.name: supported_protocols
options.description: Protocols supported by the file system. It will be overridden by NAS server configuration if NAS Server is C(Multiprotocol).

options.name: tiering_policy
options.description: Tiering policy choices for how the storage resource data will be distributed among the tiers available in the pool.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unity management server.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the Unity management server.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
